meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Processes and analyzes data with resident-kernel engines (DuckDB, Polars) and one-shot tools. Use for CSV/parquet/JSON analysis, group-by/join/aggregation, time series, distributions, cleaning, or plotting a dataset.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析本地数据文件,快速获得统计汇总与图表。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要处理表格或 CSV 等数据文件,想快速做统计和示意图。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze local data files and quickly produce statistical summaries and charts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with spreadsheets or CSV data and want quick summaries and charts.

howto.what: Claude 会先判断用哪个引擎(DuckDB 或 Polars)以及在哪里计算,再读取 CSV、Parquet、JSON 数据做分组、连接、聚合、时间序列和清洗,按要求画图,并报告行数与耗时。
howto.when: 当你要求分析数据集时触发,比如 CSV/Parquet/JSON 分析、分组或连接聚合、时间序列与分布等。

say.text: 读一下 data.csv,告诉我每个城市的订单数和平均金额。
say.note: 会直接查文件,并报告行数与耗时。

say.text: 把这份 parquet 按月份汇总,再画一张趋势图。
say.note: 先做聚合,再按可视化规范出图。

say.text: 这个文件里的缺失值怎么处理?顺便清理一下。
say.note: 先探查文件大小和行数,再清洗。

howto.what_en: Claude picks an engine (DuckDB or Polars) and where to compute, then reads CSV/Parquet/JSON for group-by, joins, aggregation, time series and cleaning, charts on request, and reports row counts and timing.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for dataset analysis, such as CSV/Parquet/JSON analysis, group-by or join and aggregation, time series and distributions.

say_en.text: Read data.csv and tell me the order count and average amount per city.
say_en.note: Queries the file directly and reports timing.

say_en.text: Aggregate this parquet by month, then draw a trend chart.
say_en.note: Aggregates first, then charts per the visual spec.

say_en.text: How should the missing values in this file be handled? Clean it.
say_en.note: Probes size and row count first, then cleans.
